headline: Lincoln hand Southwest Baptist a first defeat
dek: Lincoln beat Southwest Baptist on Sunday, the first defeat of Southwest Baptist's season, and are now the only side in the conference that has not lost. They have won two and drawn two, and have conceded three goals in all.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-five goals exceed what the six lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the conference's scoring is one bar and then a slope.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lincoln's home match with McKendree, the one conference match of 9 September without a result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: two wins and two draws, six goals scored and three conceded, with Sunday's win over Southwest Baptist their first at home.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Jewell's win at home to Harding on Tuesday was their first of the season after five defeats; they have now scored three goals and conceded nine, and the match was their first without a goal against.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southwest Baptist have won three, drawn one and lost one, scoring twenty-five and conceding five; the defeat came at Lincoln on Sunday, and eight different players have scored for them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have won five and lost one, scoring fourteen and conceding four; the defeat was at home to Oklahoma Christian, and they have not dropped a point since.

last_match.line: William Jewell's first win of the season, and the first match in which they have not conceded.

next_match.line: Southwest Baptist have lost only at Lincoln; Maryville have not lost since conference play opened.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
